articles.title: Unlocking the future of shared storage Filestore on Colossus

articles.detail: Filestore, Google Cloud's first-party, secure, scalable NFS file service, can service a wide-range of enterprise use cases as well as cutting-edge AI and agent workflows. articles.title: Multiple result sets How Database Migration Service automates SQL server to PostgreSQL translation
articles.summary: In the Medium blog post, " From MARS to SETOF REFCURSOR: Migrating Multi-Result Stored Procedures to PostgreSQL ," we explored the fundamental architectural differences between SQL Server and PostgreSQL regarding multiple result sets.
articles.detail: We looked at how SQL Server natively streams multiple tabular streams from a single execution, whereas PostgreSQL requires a more deliberate strategy using explicit cursors. In this blog post, we'll delve into how Database Migration Service automates this translation for you.

articles.title: Reintroducing Network Firewall Proxy for Secure Egress Connectivity
articles.summary: At re:Invent 2025 we launched AWS Network Firewall proxy in preview to gather feedback from customers before making it generally available.
articles.detail: That feedback was clear and consistent: customers want the flexibility to use their Network Firewall, with all its existing capabilities, as an explicit proxy. Rather than managing a separate proxy product with its own security policy model, customers told us they want the option of using the same security policies across both their AWS resources and on-premises infrastructure.
